## AI for mathematics

**[Human–AI Mathematics](https://human-ai-mathematics.github.io/)**\
An open framework for mathematical research with AI agents, in which a claim counts as
proved only after an independent review. Its first case study is a
[manuscript](https://human-ai-mathematics.github.io/kls-conjecture-search/) that
reconstructs and compares the three proofs of the KLS conjecture.
[Post](posts/human-ai-mathematics/human-ai-mathematics.qmd)

**[latexfmt](https://github.com/nbrosse/latexfmt)**\
A LaTeX formatter that understands mathematics.
`uv tool install latexfmt` · [PyPI](https://pypi.org/project/latexfmt/)

## Generative models

**[edm-error-propagation-code](https://github.com/nbrosse/edm-error-propagation-code)**\
The experiments and archived runs behind the EDM error propagation preprint: local
errors of the first-order EDM sampler and the amplification they actually undergo.
[Post](posts/edm-error-propagation/edm-error-propagation.qmd) ·
[arXiv:2610.10190](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.10190)

**[flow-matching-notes](https://github.com/nbrosse/flow-matching-notes)**\
The notebooks behind the flow matching posts:
[flow matching as posterior averaging](posts/posterior-averaging/posterior-averaging.qmd)
and [closed-form flow matching](posts/posterior-concentration/posterior-concentration.qmd).

## ML for science

**[mhcpred](https://github.com/nbrosse/mhcpred)**\
Predicting MHC class I peptide presentation with a neural network, benchmarked against
MHCflurry.
[Post](posts/mhc/mhc.qmd)

**[raman-spectra](https://github.com/nbrosse/raman-spectra)**\
Preprocessing Raman spectra and predicting analyte concentrations with PLS regression.
[Post](posts/raman/raman.qmd)

## LLM systems & agents

**[haiku-shunt](https://github.com/nbrosse/haiku-shunt)**\
A Claude Code plugin that delegates large file reads to a small model, and an A/B test
of what that actually saves.
[Post](posts/haiku-shunt/haiku-shunt.qmd)

**[llm-slide-deck](https://github.com/nbrosse/llm-slide-deck)**\
Rebuilding a real slide deck with an LLM in four formats, and where each one fails.
[Post](posts/llm-slides/llm-slides.qmd)

**[llm-observability](https://github.com/nbrosse/llm-observability)**\
End-to-end tracing of a FastHTML chatbot with Langfuse.
[Post](posts/llm-observability/llm-observability.qmd)

**[pdf-rag](https://github.com/nbrosse/pdf-rag)**\
Retrieval over a corpus of PDFs: recovering document structure with a vision language
model, extracting metadata, and querying with a two-level ReAct agent.
[Post](posts/pdf-rag/pdf-rag.qmd) ·
[demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/nicolasb92/pdf-rag-metadata-demo)

**[pdf-parsing](https://github.com/nbrosse/pdf-parsing)**\
A comparison of Docling, Marker, MinerU, pymupdf4llm, LlamaParse, Gemini and Mistral OCR
on real documents.
[Post](posts/pdf-parsing/pdf-parsing.qmd) ·
[demo](https://huggingface.co/spaces/nicolasb92/pdf-parsing-demo)
